en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on Investigation: 13.
The Question on the Characteristic of Thought (Vitakka)
“Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of applied thought?
“Applied thought, Great King, has the characteristic of mental application,” he replied.
“Give me a simile,” the king said.
“Just as, Great King, a carpenter applies a well-prepared piece of wood to a joint,
even so, Great King, is the characteristic of applied thought (vitakka).
The Thirteenth Question: The Characteristic of Applied Thought (Vitakka).
